title: PMU Foundation Model Bridge: A Tool for Connecting Synchrophasor Streams to Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents PMU Foundation Model Bridge, an open source tool that connects online phasor measurement unit (PMU) or phasor data concentrator (PDC) streams to publicly available time series foundation models (TSFM). Through a desktop interface or command line interface, users can select measurement channels, define preprocessing, choose TSFMs, and configure outputs. In the initial release, 4 publicly available TSFMs were supported, including Chronos-2, TimesFM 2.5, Timestral, and TimesFM-3. The tool supports both file and synchrophasor streaming outputs, therefore enabling both offline use and integration into C37.118-based online workflow applications. In addition to supporting raw synchrophasor data, the framework provides a preprocessing layer for deriving customized additional quantities for forecasting. The tool is validated using a virtual PMU and real-time laboratory measurements from a frequency disturbance recorder (FDR)

translated_title: PMU基础模型桥接器：一种将同步相量数据流连接到时间序列基础模型的工具
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了PMU基础模型桥接器，这是一个开源工具，可将在线相量测量单元（PMU）或相量数据集中器（PDC）数据流连接到公开可用的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。用户可以通过桌面界面或命令行界面选择测量通道、定义预处理、选择TSFM并配置输出。在初始版本中，该工具支持4个公开可用的时间序列基础模型，包括Chronos-2、TimesFM 2.5、Timestral和TimesFM-3。该工具支持文件输出和同步相量流式输出，因此既可用于离线使用，也可集成到基于C37.118的在线工作流应用中。除了支持原始同步相量数据外，该框架还提供了一个预处理层，用于推导用于预测的定制附加量。该工具通过虚拟PMU和来自频率扰动记录仪（FDR）的实时实验室测量数据进行了验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一个开源工具PMU基础模型桥接器，能够将PMU/PDC同步相量数据流连接到多种公开可用的时间序列基础模型，并支持基于C37.118的在线工作流和离线分析。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PMU Foundation Model Bridge, an open source tool that connects PMU/PDC synchrophasor streams to publicly available time series foundation models, enabling both C37.118-based online workflows and offline analysis.
